scope: FFmpeg's xbr filter (libavfilter/vf_xbr.c) at n=2, 3 and 4 on a seeded 10x8 synthetic image that reaches every blend of each factor; render::xbr's test compares the port with it.
input: rgba, one hex row per image row, saved as an RGB PNG with its clear pixels black: xbr filters 0RGB32 and reads no alpha.
replay_command: ffmpeg -v error -i input.png -vf xbr=n=<n> -f rawvideo -pix_fmt rgb24 scaled.rgb
outputs: scaled.<n> holds scaled.rgb for n, one hex row per output row.
